svg.title: Step responses of a buffer: a small step settles exponentially while a large step first ramps at the slew rate
svg.text: Linear settling versus slewing in a unity-gain buffer
linear response to a 1 V step (ideal)
1 V step: ramps at the slew rate, then settles
Here τ = 10 ns and SR = 40 V/μs. A linear system's initial slope is proportional to the
step (V/τ); once that exceeds SR the output ramps instead.
